answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 5 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the relic release is written down with every signature, the pearl audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the hollow graph and each risks its bond. That is 18 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
